column5: I feel like the devil is attacking my faith. What did Wesley say about Satan's devices?
column8: #42 Satan's Devices, wesley-042-c0007: We trust in his promise who cannot lie, that the time will surely come, when, in every word and work, we shall do his blessed will on earth, as it is done in heaven; when all our conversation shall be seasoned with salt, all meet to minister grace to the hearers; when, whether we eat or drink, or whatever we do, it shall be done to the glory of God; when all our words and deeds shall be "in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks unto God, even the Father, through him." 5. «Now this is the grand device of Satan, to destroy the first work of God in the soul, or at least to hinder its increase, by our expectation of that greater work.»
column9:
1. #42 Satan's Devices (wesley-042-c0010): «that subtle adversary often damps the joy we should otherwise feel in what we have already attained, by a perverse representation of what we have not attained» Reason: Names a specific device: Satan dampens joy by fixing our eyes on what we lack rather than what God has done.
2. #42 Satan's Devices (wesley-042-c0012): «If he can prevail thus far, if he can damp our joy, he will soon attack our peace also. He will suggest, "Are you fit to see God?» Reason: Describes how Satan attacks peace by suggesting we are too unholy to be accepted by God.
3. #42 Satan's Devices (wesley-042-c0024): «At the same time that our wise adversary endeavours to make our conviction of the necessity of perfect love an occasion of shaking our peace by doubts and fears, he endeavours to weaken, if not destroy, our faith.» Reason: Explains that Satan's aim is to weaken faith, since peace and holiness stand or fall with it.
4. #42 Satan's Devices (wesley-042-c0030): «there is, many times, no spirit left in them; they could almost cry out, "With God this is impossible!" They are ready to give up both faith and hope» Reason: Describes exactly the losing heart the asker feels, as the effect of this temptation on earnest believers.
5. #42 Satan's Devices (wesley-042-c0044): «You may cast back this dart upon his own head, while through the grace of God, the more you feel of your own vileness, the more you rejoice in confident hope, that all this shall be done away.» Reason: First counter-move: turn Satan's accusation into hope that God will finish the work.
6. #42 Satan's Devices (wesley-042-c0047): «take the more earnest heed to hold fast that, "Not by works of righteousness which I have done, I am found in him; I am accepted in the Beloved» Reason: When Satan assaults peace, hold fast that acceptance rests on Christ's righteousness by faith, not our own.
7. #42 Satan's Devices (wesley-042-c0050): «The more you are tempted to give up your shield, to cast away your faith, your confidence in his love, so much the more take heed that you hold fast that whereunto you have attained» Reason: Direct counsel for when the devil pushes you to abandon faith: hold fast your confidence in Christ's love.
8. #72 Of Evil Angels (wesley-072-c0028): «By this means he assaults our faith, our evidence of things unseen. He endeavours to weaken that hope full of immortality to which God had begotten us» Reason: Explains how the devil attacks believers' faith, hope, joy and especially love of God.
9. #72 Of Evil Angels (wesley-072-c0049): «And, First, as a general preservative against all the rage, the power, and subtlety of your great adversary, put on the panoply, "the whole armour of God," universal holiness.» Reason: Wesley's first defence against Satan's attacks: put on the whole armour of God.
10. #72 Of Evil Angels (wesley-072-c0053): «If he inject doubts whether you are a child of God, or fears lest you should not endure to the end; "take to you for a helmet the hope of salvation."» Reason: Counsel for devil-injected doubts about being God's child: hold fast the hope of salvation.
11. #72 Of Evil Angels (wesley-072-c0055): «"resist" him, "steadfast in the faith." Then is the time, having cried to the Strong for strength, to "stir up the gift of God that is in you;"» Reason: When Satan assaults, cry to God for strength and resist steadfast in faith, and he will flee.
12. #46 The Wilderness State (wesley-046-c0044): «Particularly when we reason with this enemy, instead of instantly calling upon God, and casting ourselves upon Him, by simple faith» Reason: Practical counsel under attack: don't argue with the enemy; instantly call on God in simple faith.
13. #47 Heaviness through Manifold Temptations (wesley-047-c0034): «And if we attempt to fight him with his own weapons, if we begin to reason with him, more and more heaviness will undoubtedly ensue, if not utter darkness.» Reason: Satan tries to stir the heart against God when we are low; reasoning with him only deepens the darkness.
14. #19 The Great Privilege of those that are Born of God (wesley-019-c0049): «that if the loving eye of the soul be steadily fixed on God, the temptation soon vanishes away» Reason: How to avoid the snare of the devil: keep the soul's eye fixed on God and watch unto prayer.
15. #82 On Temptation (wesley-082-c0053): «lest he tempt God, by thinking or saying, "This is insupportable; this is too hard; I can never get through it; my burden is heavier that I can bear." Not so; unless something is too hard for God.» Reason: Answers losing heart under temptation: God proportions the trial to our strength; ask and more is given.
16. #42 Satan's Devices (wesley-042-c0019): «if your eye be not steadily fixed on Him who hath borne all your sins, he will bring you again under that "fear of death,"» Reason: Warns how Satan wears down peace and joy with fear; the defence is keeping your eye fixed on Christ who bore your sins.
17. #78 Spiritual Idolatry (wesley-078-c0043): «You are not able to contend with the evil world, much less with your own evil heart; and least of all, with the powers of darkness. Cry, therefore, to the Strong for strength.» Reason: Direct counsel for resisting the pull of the world and temptation: do not trust your own strength; cry to God for strength.
18. #78 Spiritual Idolatry (wesley-078-c0047): «fight the good fight of faith; take the kingdom of heaven by violence!» Reason: Exhorts the believer to fight on and stand fast in Christ's liberty, doing all things through Christ who strengthens.
19. #19 The Great Privilege of those that are Born of God (wesley-019-c0055): «Thou, therefore, O man of God! watch always; that thou mayest always hear the voice of God! Watch, that thou mayest pray without ceasing» Reason: Counsel to those who stand: watch and pray always so that inward sin does not regain dominion.

column5: Something keeps pulling me away from God and wearing me down until I want to give up. How do I stand firm?
